quests.title: The Foolish Fatuus

dialogue.t: Shhh, {NICKNAME}, look over there! An Eremite member and... a Fatuus!
Kasim... how are these Saghira Machines working?
Working good, Oleg...
This is the result report. And if nothing goes wrong, it won't take long for you to get what you want...
Hahaha, great! With your help, we will be able to complete the order of our Lord Harbingers in no time.
But if you dare lie to me... you will pay the price!
What's in it for me to lie to you?
Anyway, you know what I mean.
Hmph, Trofin Snezhevich... That guy didn't achieve anything here in the past few years, whereas I have already gotten results. Well, won't we see what he has to say for himself then?
Trofin Snezhevich... I've never heard that name in Sumeru...
Haha, of course you haven't. Surely he wouldn't use this name to reveal himself... The Lord Harbinger sent him here, but he's made no progress all these years.
...Wait, wh—who is there? How did you get in here?
Oops, {NICKNAME}, they found us!
...I should leave now.
Hm, Fatuus, you won't lose to some random adventurer who broke in, will you?
None of your business, Eremite guy. I'll beat down this rude intruder and head to the research camp we talked about.

dialogue.sit: Kasim leaves...

dialogue.t: If I weren't exhausted by retaking the camp... Ugh, I'll get you next time!

dialogue.sit: Oleg runs away amidst the chaos...

dialogue.t: Huh, that's a quick getaway...
Wait, the thing he left behind is... an "Emergency Adjustment Plan"?
Let's see what it says...

"Since the Saghira Machine operation is an important link in Snezhnaya's research projects in Sumeru, there is no room for failure... Recently our research camps have suffered from repeated breaches of security, resulting in the breakdown of the machines..."
Huh, someone broke through their camps multiple times. That's impressive. Paimon wonders who those kind and brave people are!

dialogue.sit: It's us!
No one else but us!

dialogue.t: Hehe, yeah. Then, "we need to retake the camp. Patrols will be stepped up today... Make your rounds <color=#00E1FFFF>in the order of the camps marked on this map...</color>"
As you can see in this picture, the camp we are in is the starting point for the patrol.
So they need to recapture these four camps! Interesting that the Fatui would seek help from the Eremites...
Uh... And it goes "...set out from the action stronghold and execute the above plan." So they even have an operation stronghold...
Hmph, if only we knew where this operation stronghold is...

dialogue.sit: Let's wipe them all out!

dialogue.t: Uh-huh! Now let's head to the camps in order. We'll definitely catch the Fatui!
Argh, lost again...
I bet you are one of those who'd do anything for Mora, right?
How about this? I give you Mora, and you get out of the way, you in?
Whoa, {NICKNAME}, this Fatui guy does know us well!
But listen, we'll take the Mora...

dialogue.sit: But we won't stay away!

dialogue.t: Ugh, why are you so annoying? That's some beef between us, just you wait!

dialogue.sit: Oleg runs away amidst the chaos...

dialogue.t: Hmm, Paimon couldn't even see his moves... it's like one blink, and he's gone!
This Fatuus is actually skilled in running away!
One... Two... Next up is camp number three on the patrol route. We aren't gonna run into him there, right...
Geez, what are you after?
To stop you from doing bad things, of course!

dialogue.sit: Tell us what the machines are used for!

dialogue.t: ...Hmph, no way. You must be daydreaming!
Ugh, I've fought too much today... Gotta get some rest at the stronghold...

dialogue.sit: Oleg runs away amidst the chaos...

dialogue.t: Ugh, how does he manage to escape every time? Just why...
Paimon guesses he had no idea that we had his plan, though. Just look at his surprised face...
He said he was going back to base to rest. In other words, he won't be patrolling the last camp on the map...

dialogue.sit: But according to the Emergency Adjustment Plan...
Let's just take it as clearing out the Fatui!

dialogue.t: Yes, you're right. We can't leave the weird suction fans activated like that...
Ouch... Geez, don't hit me... Stooop that!
Are you really some legendary bandit...?

dialogue.sit: You're much weaker than I imagined...

dialogue.t: Not every bandit is known for their physical strength...
Hm, that's a slick tongue. We should really ask him some right questions!
Go ahead. I promise I'll tell everything in my knowledge, hehe...

dialogue.sit: Are you really a bandit from the Eremites?

dialogue.t: Yes, sure...

dialogue.sit: The Eremites certainly aren't picky about who they recruit.
Then let's go and meet the Corps of Thirty...

dialogue.t: We are the Eremites, after all. We're from different places and all walks of life, haha!
Speaking of this, how on earth did the Fatui find you?
They came for my hard-earned reputation in the Eremites, of course...

dialogue.sit: The Eremites are Sumeru locals after all...
Don't get cocky! Tell the truth!

dialogue.t: Some sages in the Akademiya are officially in cooperation with the Fatui, but the Fatui can't really reach Sumeru through the secret moves... And that's when I come to help!
He's actually proud...
In short, the Fatui turned to you for some strange experiment, telling you to set the suspicious suction fans in the camps...
Ah, so you're asking about the Saghira Machines. The Fatui somehow wanted something for energy extraction from Withering Zones, so I provided some...
Machines for energy extraction from Withering Zones!?
That's right. It took me quite some effort to dig them out of the ruins...

dialogue.sit: Really?
You're lying again! Is your face itching or what?

dialogue.t: Seems that anything could appear in the Sumeru ruins...
I have no idea whether the Withering Zones are really drained of energy or not. Anyway, the Fatui know nothing about it, and I would always make up some experiment results...
What's that? You're lying to the Fatui too!
Well, hehe, isn't that good news to you...
That's true though... Paimon doesn't know which is more evil between you and the Fatui.
Speaking of this, since you've been working with the Fatui for so long, Paimon bets you know where their stronghold is!
Ah, as things stand now, I might as well tell you everything... I've been providing fake experiment results, and they seem to be suspecting me...
I'll reveal the location of the stronghold. Please catch them. This way, the Fatui would never know that I've been fabricating the results...
Wow, he's really rotten to the core. The Fatui got into some serious trouble cooperating with him!

dialogue.sit: Let's just hear him out for now...

dialogue.t: Near the tents in the Apam Woods, there are four torches. Light them at night...
And the Fatui will respond with signal lights. So if you see bright spots on nearby cliffs...
That means the Fatui operation stronghold lies right there! What an interesting communication method...
Yes. The Fatui behind the gate will ask you for the watchword, and only those who get it right can enter...
They even set up a watchword!
That's right. Let me see, the first half is "Never bring your own rule book..."
And the second half is "to someone else's place."
Wow, hope the Fatui could actually honor their watchword...
Come on, let's try it out. "Never bring your own rule book..."

dialogue.sit: "To someone else's place."

dialogue.t: Great, go ahead! For the sake of not revealing my true identity to the Fatui, please catch them!
Hehe, see... I've given you such important information. Perhaps you could, you know... let me off the hook...
Hmph, behave yourself after this! If you're found doing any tricks again... we'll see you with the Corps of Thirty!
Sure, with you two here in Sumeru, I won't do anything mischievous ever, ever again! So, just forgive me this time!
Hehe, I'll get outta here then. Wish you success!

dialogue.sit: Kasim flees in a hurry...

dialogue.t: Um... Maybe we should send this guy to the Sheriff...
But we might as well deal with the Fatui first.
Their stronghold... Ah, of course I know where it is... It's located in...
...Ah, can you see the mountains over there?
The mountains over there? You mean that's where the Fatui stronghold lies?
But Paimon doesn't see anything unusual there. Kasim... Huh? Where did he go?

dialogue.sit: He must've sneaked away!

dialogue.t: Wah, that's so despicable!
We were so close to the key information!
But Kasim was initially meeting with the Fatui here... Maybe we can find some clues around.
Let's check the camp first!
Eh? No way... Ahem, watchword, please. "Never bring your own rule book..."

dialogue.sit: "To someone else's place."

dialogue.t: Hmph, come in already, you... Hmph, you must be the newbies here for support. What took you so long?
You have no idea how important this experiment is! You are not only late, but...
Hmph, and you took over the camps, stopped the Saghira Machines, and interrupted our experiment!

dialogue.sit: Uh-oh!

dialogue.t: Come on, I've been attacked... I've fought you three times... What made you think you could fool me with a mask...
Do you know why I let you in even after I recognized you? Well, it's a trap!
Get her(him)! This is the brat that hampered our experiment!
We were actually defeated... even with so many members...
If only the experiments went well, I would...
Nah, that's not gonna happen. The machine named San-something from Kasim won't extract anything from the Withering Zones...
That's to say, he's been lying to you all this time!
Just how!
You can repent all you want with the Corps of Thirty, and remember to stay away from Sumeru for the rest of your life!

dialogue.sit:
You inform Parchamdar Rukh Shah from the Corps of Thirty.
He and his subordinates take the Fatui away.

dialogue.t: Were it not for you, we'd never have known what suspicious things the camp has been used for... We will take away these Fatui.

According to researchers' investigation, even though no influence was exerted on the Withering Zones, the mere operation of the machines has somehow polluted the environment. If we failed to stop them in time...
The forest might be damaged.

dialogue.sit: I see...

dialogue.t: Yes, the Corps of Thirty will take custody of these machines, and similar incidents should be prevented in the future...
But due to ownership issues, it may not be possible to bring all the camps under our direct management... I won't be too worried about it though.
Besides, the bounty on Kasim has been raised according to your report... That guy has always been a fraud that gives us headaches.
Even those Eremite mercenaries fell for his scam this time. He went behind the Corps of Thirty and contacted them directly, offering to share a huge payout for extracting energy from the Ley Lines...
Never mind. I'll teach him a lesson the next time I see him!
Here, take your rewards for turning in the Fatui! We caught them all thanks to you.

dialogue.sit: Rukh Shah leaves...

dialogue.t: I must thank you both.
And let me know if you have any clues about Kasim's whereabouts.

quests.description: There are several strange camps in the Sumeru forest, and each camp has a strange machine installed within. The Fatui seem to be using these machines to do something weird. It’s best to investigate this matter…
